about: Greater Sudbury is in northeastern Ontario, on the Canadian Shield around a large mining basin. The amalgamated city is one of Ontario’s geographically largest municipalities, built from several former towns. Nickel mining, a university, and hundreds of lakes shape local life. About 170,000 people live in Greater Sudbury.
seoSummary: Northeastern Ontario mining city on the Shield, with hundreds of lakes inside city limits.
